title: Prospect
description: One discovered local business, before or after scoring/qualification. Unknown fields must be null, not omitted, so downstream scripts can rely on key presence.

maps_position.description: Local pack / Maps rank for the target keyword, if measured

organic_position.description: Organic SERP rank for the target money keyword, if measured

obvious_website_issue.description: Free-text tags observed at discovery time, e.g. thin_service_pages, no_online_booking, slow_site, no_https, outdated_design, weak_cta

obvious_gbp_issue.description: e.g. missing_categories, few_photos, unanswered_reviews, incomplete_hours, no_qanda

competitor_gap.description: Short notes on what named competitors have that this business doesn't

commercial_value_signal.description: Rough estimate of ticket size / lead value for this business; 'none' triggers a hard reject

verified_business.description: Confirmed operating (site live, phone valid, GBP claimed/active, etc.)

content_hash.description: Hash of homepage+key pages content, used for cache invalidation

status.description: SCORED is a legacy V1 alias, no longer produced but still accepted on old records; V2 produces INITIAL_SCORE instead. V3.1 (qualify_leads.py --v3) adds the FRANCHISE_*/COMMERCIAL_FIT_*/BUYING_SIGNALS_*/CONTACTABILITY_*/GOOGLE_GAP_*/FIT_SCORED/GAP_SCORED/HIGH_PRIORITY states -- these are a parallel qualification track that runs instead of (not in addition to) V2's INITIAL_SCORE->NEEDS_ENRICHMENT/QUALIFIED path; a record is on one track or the other, never both at once. V3.8.1 adds CANDIDATE_VERIFIED/CANDIDATE_REJECTED -- a THIRD, deliberately terminal track produced only by discovery-only mode (scripts/discovery_worker.py): CANDIDATE_VERIFIED means deterministic basic verification passed and the record is handed off via the CANDIDATES Google Sheet for ChatGPT+user to continue; CANDIDATE_REJECTED means it failed that cheap deterministic gate. Neither status is currently in acquisition_worker.py's STAGE_A_STATUSES, so a CANDIDATE_VERIFIED record is NOT automatically picked up by a later full_pipeline run -- promoting one into the full research pipeline is a deliberate future step (e.g. a human resetting its status to BUSINESS_VERIFIED), not an automatic side effect of this status existing.

score.description: Alias for confirmed_score, kept for V1 compatibility

confirmed_score.description: Score from KNOWN fields only -- missing data contributes zero, never a penalty

potential_score.description: Best-case score if every currently-missing high-value field turned out favorable

data_completeness.description: Percent of tracked evidence fields that are actually known

properties._comment_v3_1: Everything below is V3.1 (qualify_leads.py --v3). All optional/nullable so old V2 records still load unchanged -- absent keys are treated as null by every V3.1 script via .get().

possible_franchise.description: Cheap blocklist match against config/franchise_blocklist.yaml -- a match does NOT imply corporate_marketing_controlled

corporate_marketing_controlled.description: true only if research confirms local management cannot buy its own local SEO -- this, not possible_franchise, is what blocks the pipeline

lead_gen_network.description: true if the discovered 'business' is actually a lead-gen/directory/aggregator platform, not a contactable local business

paid_search_organic_gap.description: derived: true when ads/LSA confirmed AND organic/maps visibility is weak or unknown

buying_signal_confidence.description: V3.1 legacy summary field, superseded by buying_signal_tiers in V3.1.1 but kept for backward compatibility

buying_signal_tiers.description: V3.1.1: signal_type -> 'STRONG_VERIFIED'/'VERIFIED'/'WEAK'/'UNUSABLE'/null, from scripts/signal_evidence.py: resolve_signal. HIGH_PRIORITY and why_now may only consume a signal whose tier here is VERIFIED or STRONG_VERIFIED -- a bare true value with no tier (or a WEAK one) can never independently trigger either.

signal_conflicts.description: signal_types where fresh evidence disagreed on the value (schemas/signal_evidence.schema.json) -- these stay null/unresolved until a human reconciles the conflicting evidence, never arbitrarily picked

why_now.description: null/absent means no defensible timing signal -- keeps the lead at QUALIFIED, not HIGH_PRIORITY

properties._comment_v3_2: V3.2 intelligence-layer summary fields. Full detail lives in data/leads/<id>/{opportunity_candidates.json, primary_wedge.json, intelligence_dossier.json, staged_asset.json} -- these are just the flat fields useful for filtering/reporting.

intelligence_content_hash.description: content_hash of the pages fetched during the deterministic scan -- reused for intelligence cache invalidation, separate from V1's dossier-level content_hash

qualification_tier.description: Snapshot of status at V3.2 entry, since `status` itself advances through the intelligence pipeline -- route_to_specialist.py's agent-budget gate reads this, never the live `status`
